signs.title: THE SLUICE EXCHANGE
signs.text: UPPER VIADUCT EAST / F TO TALK

signs.title: SIGNAL ROOM ABOVE
signs.text: OPTIONAL ROOF LOOP / RETURNS TO VIADUCT

signs.title: MANIFOLD / QUIET GALLERY
signs.text: F TO READ / MAIN ROUTE CONTINUES EAST

signs.title: TURN WEST / DESCEND
signs.text: FOLLOW THE LIT RETURN GALLERY BELOW

signs.title: WEST TO THE PUMP CHAMBER
signs.text: THIS ROUTE FOLDS BACK THROUGH THE EXCHANGE

signs.title: TURN EAST / LOWER WORKS
signs.text: CULVERT WEST IS OPTIONAL / HOLD DOWN TO CROUCH

signs.title: LOW SERVICE CULVERT
signs.text: HOLD S OR DOWN / RETURN EAST

signs.title: LOWER CROSSING EAST
signs.text: MISSED A JUMP? TOWPATH BELOW REJOINS AHEAD

signs.title: RETURN EAST TO THE WORKS
signs.text: DO NOT CHASE THE WATER / TAKE THE STEPS

signs.title: EXCHANGE EXIT
signs.text: WAIT FOR THE SHIELD TO OPEN / EXIT EAST
